title: Implement MIME parser producing IPLD MIME node (v1: text parts only)
description: Parse the NNTP body as MIME. For single-part articles: decode the transfer encoding (7bit, 8bit, quoted-printable, base64) and produce a decoded_cid raw block. For multipart articles: recursively parse parts and produce a parts list with decoded_cid per part. Binary parts (non-text content-type): produce a decoded_cid pointing to the raw undecoded bytes plus a binary=true flag; do not attempt further decoding in v1. Returns None for articles with no Content-Type header (treat as text/plain verbatim).
notes: Size: M. Depends on Issue B (MIME node schema) and Issue E (body block builder).
